ns2:section.sectionText: New freshmen in Grainger College of Engineering, Math&CS, Stat&CS, ChemE or Physics must enroll in lecture EL1 or EL2. Continuing students in these programs who register after May 28, 2021, should e-mail mathadvising@illinois.edu with name, UIN, and continuing status to receive an override.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Grainger Engineering. Not intended for Physics or Chemical Engineering or Statistics & Computer Science or Math & Computer Science major(s).
